thread:
maya: Heads-up — overnight release window 02:00 UTC. Deploybot scheduled canary at 02:15. We will hold if latency or error signals breach thresholds. @sam can you own the customer comm?
sam: on it. I’ll draft statuspage + email. what's the pin strategy if canary shows regressions?
maya: Quick plan: if canary error_rate > 2% for 10m OR p95 latency > +20% -> pin affected Dedicated customers to previous stable (v3.1.4) and hold rollout. For Hosted we'll divert new traffic and monitor.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2024-11-10T02:15:00Z; canary group: 5%; version: v3.2.0; runbook: /runbooks/release-canary.md
zack: FYI I saw a perf spike on test cluster yesterday with the model variant — +18% p95 for long prompts. Recommend we pre-stage pin paths and add stricter canary triggers.
maya: good catch. support-lead, please draft customer-facing copy: short statuspage blurb + short email. Explicitly say we will pin if we detect regression. Keep tone calm.
support-lead: Drafting now. Proposed statuspage snippet: 
```
We will perform a scheduled release (models + runtime optimizations) on 2024-11-10 02:00 UTC. Impact: a small subset of Dedicated instances may experience brief increases in inference latency or transient errors during the canary. If regressions are detected we will pin affected instances to v3.1.4 and provide updates. Expected window: ~90 minutes.
```
sam: email copy (short): 
```
Subject: Upcoming release — possible brief latency for some Dedicated customers
Hi — We’re rolling out an update to improve throughput and reliability. During the canary (02:15 UTC) a small subset of Dedicated instances may see increased latency or transient errors. If we detect a regression we will pin affected instances to the previous stable version and notify you. No action required. Status updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/RELEASE-2024-11-10
```
ops-oncall: Ops checklist (short): smoke tests post-canary, monitor p95, error rate, KV cache hit ratio. Rollback/pin command: `./deploy rollback --version v3.1.4 --scope dedicated`. Alert channels: #eng-oncall, #support.
maya: Decision matrix recap: error_rate >= 2% sustained over 10m OR p95 >= +20% -> hold and pin. Otherwise continue phased rollout with 30/60/100% steps.
sam: I’ll post the statuspage & email drafts 45 minutes before window. Will include a link to the runbook and the status incident. Any objections to copy?
zack: none from me, +1. Also recommend we attach a short technical note for platform customers who want opt-in testing.
support-lead: posting draft to the staging statuspage now. tagging comms for legal review.
maya: @deploy-bot please set canary-hold triggers to error_rate=0.02 and p95_multiplier=1.20 and notify the oncall channel.
deploy-bot: Canary hold triggers set: error_rate_threshold=0.02; p95_multiplier=1.20; notify_channels=[#eng-oncall,#support]; hold_action=pin_to_v3.1.4
sam: Perfect. I’ll schedule the outbound customer email and post final statuspage copy 30m prior.
maya: Closing — if anything changes before window, call it out here or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
